subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept persisted announceLastRun plus non-running "killed" reconciliation as canonical recovery behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those turns always tool-free?
rationale: The implementation is coherent, but it changes session-state lifecycle semantics and internal tool access for inter-session announce delivery, which are maintainer-owned compatibility and safety choices.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, announce-prefix convention, and tool-free announce invariant as the fix for this cascade.

options.title: Adjust recovery state first
options.body: Change the reconciliation target, lifecycle naming, or prefix handling before merge while preserving the announce-vs-human turn distinction.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery model
options.body: Hold the PR if maintainers want announce, lock, and delivery recovery solved through a wider session-delivery redesign first.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, announce-prefix convention, and tool-free announce invariant as the fix for this cascade.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history ties jalehman to the restart lifecycle, gateway lifecycle state, and Codex tool-surface paths most central to this choice.
